# Abstract
# --------
# Exact versions of atheris and NumPy for the fuzz targets in fuzz/,
# compiled from requirements-ci-fuzz.in.
#
# Every distribution carries its SHA-256 hash; install the file with
#   python -m pip install --require-hashes -r .github/requirements/requirements-ci-fuzz.txt
# so pip refuses any file that differs from the reviewed one (OpenSSF
# Scorecard, Pinned-Dependencies). One file covers CPython 3.10 to 3.14.
#
# Do not edit the uv output by hand: change requirements-ci-fuzz.in and run
# `make lock`; `make lock-check` fails when this file is out of date.
#
# The list below is generated by uv. Each entry shows which requirement pulled
# the package in ("via").
# =============================================================================
